args: const fs=require('node:fs'),{spawnSync}=require('node:child_process');(async()=>{const role=process.argv[1],tools=process.argv[2],p=process.env.A2A_CREDENTIALS_PATH,u=process.env.FORGE_TOKEN_URL,r=process.env.FORGE_REPOSITORY;if(!p||!u||!r)throw Error('missing forge token environment');const c=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8')).credentials?.[0]?.token;if(!c)throw Error('missing A2A credential');const x=await fetch(u,{method:'POST',headers:{authorization:'Bearer '+c,'content-type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({role,repository:r})});if(!x.ok)throw Error('forge token request failed: '+x.status);const t=(await x.json()).token;if(!t)throw Error('forge token response missing token');const q=spawnSync('github-mcp-server',['stdio','--tools',tools],{stdio:'inherit',env:{...process.env,GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN:t}});process.exit(q.status??1)})().catch(e=>{console.error(e.message);process.exit(1)})
